items.title: Why Is Ross Stores (ROST) Warning On Q3 EPS And Holiday Inventory?
items.summary: Ross Stores (NasdaqGS:ROST) guided to lower Q3 earnings per share as it prepares its upcoming quarterly update. Management flagged higher inventory levels tied to holiday assortments and signalled that markdowns may be needed to clear stock. The retailer expressed caution around holiday shopping demand, adding pressure to near term margin expectations.
